_README: THIS IS THE ONE PLACE THE PARENT-CONSENT WORDING LIVES. To change the wording: edit 'items' below AND change 'version' (for example 2026-12-v2). The version is stored with every consent, and parents whose children were consented under an older version are asked to read and accept the new text again. A lawyer must review this text before launch ('draft' must become false afterwards).
title: Parent consent for a child profile

items.text: I am this child’s parent or legal guardian, and I am 18 or older.
AKILI will keep only: a nickname, the child’s age (or birth year), an avatar, a PIN, and learning progress (lessons done, points, badges, code and answers the child submits).
AKILI will not collect photos, location, a full name, or contacts, will not show ads, and will not let children chat with strangers.
This information is used only to run lessons, track progress for me, and keep the account safe. It is not sold or shared with advertisers.
I can see, download, and delete everything about my child at any time from my dashboard, and I can switch my child’s account off.
